column1: # Measured wall seconds of one package under `go test -race` (CHAOS-6690), the weight ci/go_race_shard.awk balances the
# race shards by. The weights only need to be roughly right: a stale one costs balance, never coverage (the shards always
# partition the full package list). Key = import path relative to the module root. Sorted (LC_ALL=C), no duplicates;
# tests/tooling/test_go_quality_legs.py checks each row names a real package.
# CHAOS-8135: EVERY package of the root module has a row, and ci/check_go.sh check_race_shard fails a race leg BEFORE it runs
# when one is missing (ci/go_race_missing_rows.awk), so a new heavy package can never take the default weight and hide its
# cost from the shard plan (httpguard: 324 s, no row, shared a leg with goapiproof). A new package adds its row: its measured
# `go test -race` seconds, 1 when it has no test.
# Values: the largest CI race-leg time of the package over the go-quality race legs of main 45aa5b00ab, 2e2fec51e3,
# 561606bce8 and the PRs #3651 and #3663 (rows of 20 s or more: the seven legs that did not time out; lighter rows: the
# largest time of any of the ten legs, 1 s at least, also for a package with no test).
